science.description: Langlais et al. (2019) · degree 134 · surface model

grid.noDataEvidence: The data set catalogue gives the derived range as 5 to 5000 and says higher and lower values are not computed; 0 marks a cell without a value (https://pds-geosciences.wustl.edu/mgs/mgs-m-tes-5-timap-v1/mgst_9001/catalog/dataset.cat).

mask.evidence: datainfo.txt: a mask value of 0 marks pixels infilled by interpolation; the catalogue removes them by multiplying the map by the mask (https://pds-geosciences.wustl.edu/mgs/mgs-m-tes-5-timap-v1/mgst_9001/data/datainfo.txt, https://pds-geosciences.wustl.edu/mgs/mgs-m-tes-5-timap-v1/mgst_9001/catalog/dataset.cat).

grid.georeferenceEvidence: ASU's catalogue record gives a 16 pixel-per-degree global grid (https://mars.asu.edu/data/tes_ruffdust/); at a −180° east left edge the map reproduces Ruff & Christensen (2002): Arabia 0.922 (dust-covered, ≤ 0.940), Syrtis Major 0.973 and Mare Erythraeum 0.968 (their regional average 0.970).
grid.noDataEvidence: Exactly 0.85, 21% of cells, all poleward of about 60° N and 80° S, below every value the paper discusses (0.90 and up): a constant fill where TES data are excluded, not a measurement.
